Yes. The two destinations work particularly well together because of their geographic proximity and their historical connections to George Washington. Combining them provides a broader picture of his private, commercial, civic, and public life.

But you will learn of its creation, the events that led up to its creation as well as the key players behind the story.

From real mummies inside the Smithsonian to the American Obelisk and the eternal Reflecting Pool, this tour transforms Washington into a living extension of Egypt’s timeless legacy.

We do not visit Egypt inside a building only —
We discover Egypt written across the soul of Washington.

1. U.S. Capitol

Theme: Power, Law & Sacred Authority

  • Ma’at → Justice → Constitution
  • Divine leadership in Egypt vs. Democracy in America
  • Sacred geometry → political order
  • Pharaohs → Presidents

2. Library of Congress

Theme: The House of Eternal Knowledge

  • Egypt → Greece → Rome → America
  • Hieroglyphs → Arabic → English
  • Library of Alexandria reborn
  • Knowledge as Egypt’s greatest universal gift

Theme: The Living Body of Civilization

  • Real mummies
  • Sarcophagi
  • Gods & goddesses
  • Daily life tools
  • Medicine, astronomy & afterlife
  • Death → Resurrection → Eternity

This is where Egypt is seen face to face.

4. Washington Monument

Theme: The American Obelisk

  • Direct Egyptian obelisk symbolism
  • Sun worship, resurrection & eternity
  • Mathematical perfection
  • Washington as modern cosmic axis

5. Lincoln Memorial & Reflecting Pool

Theme: Judgment, Memory & Moral Legacy

  • Lincoln seated like a Pharaoh
  • Water as symbolic Nile
  • Afterlife, remembrance & legacy
  • The Hall of Truth

6. Jefferson Memorial – Tidal Basin

Theme: Light, Creation & Cosmic Order

  • Sacred circular design
  • Water & rebirth
  • Enlightenment as modern Ra
  • Eternal cycle of civilization

Egypt → Knowledge → Body → Power → Law → Memory → Eternity

Egypt gave the world:

  • Science
  • Architecture
  • Time
  • Astronomy
  • Medicine
  • Ethics
  • Leadership

America reshaped these into:

  • Democracy
  • Law
  • Liberty
  • Global leadership

 welcome to Explore Egypt in Washington, D.C. — a journey where ancient civilization meets modern power.

Our story begins at the U.S. Capitol, where the Egyptian concept of sacred authority transformed into the American idea of law and democracy.

At the Library of Congress, we step into the world’s greatest house of knowledge — where the wisdom of Ancient Egypt lives beside the memory of all human civilizations.

Inside the National Museum of Natural History, we meet Egypt face to face: real mummies, real kings, real science, and the eternal belief in resurrection.

Before us rises the American Obelisk — the Washington Monument — directly inspired by Egypt’s sacred monuments of eternity.

At the Lincoln Memorial, we reflect upon moral judgment, legacy, and the sacred role of leadership.

And finally, at the Jefferson Memorial, surrounded by water and light, we witness the eternal rebirth of civilization.

This is not a tour.
This is a civilization revelation.”

label: Alexandria & Mount Vernon Tour
content:
The Alexandria & Mount Vernon Tour is a Live, in Person Tour that includes transportation by minibus or van and a professional tour guide. It is not digital program.

Alexandria & Mount Vernon Tour

The Alexandria & Mount Vernon tour is one of the most popular attraction in Washington DC tourism. It is one of the top landmarks after we drive through Old Alexandria, some 20 miles south of DC. It gives you a unique view of George Washington monument with a drive through George Washington Memorial Parkway on the way to Old Alexandria. Come experience the boyhood home of Robert E Lee, Christ Church, George Washington masonic temple, Lyceum Museum and more… The tour will proceed with a visit of the Mt Vernon home of George Washington that lasts approximately 2 hours or more. Inside the plantation you will have the opportunity to listen to an audio tour as you visit the estate, the museum and the tombs of George and Martha Washington. The audio is a narrated exploration of the lives of Washington’s family, and friends and his enslaved workers. The audio tour discusses and interprets the stops inside the George Washington estate. 

You will get a chance to listen to onsite experts share the history of the buildings in the plantation.

Learn about the life of George Washington and enjoy touring the most famous historical estate in America!

tour is available every day except Fridays and lasts 4 hours

content:
Zohery Tours Int’l offers of 

Explore Egypt in Washington, D.C. A Living Civilization Experience is a Live, in Person Tour that includes transportation by minibus or van and a professional tour guide. It is not digital program.

Price: $49 per person

in Washington DC. The Owner and Founder of Zohery Tours, Dr. Ali Zohery, Ph.D. will present

Explore Egypt in Washington, D.C. A Living Civilization Experience

. Dr Zohery with Egyptology background will take you back in history and explore the Treasures of the Land of the Pharaohs and answer any questions in your mind about Egypt the Cradle of the Civilization. Explore Egypt in Washington, D.C. is a powerful civilization experience that connects Ancient Egypt to America’s most iconic monuments. From real mummies inside the Smithsonian to the American Obelisk and the eternal Reflecting Pool, this tour transforms Washington into a living extension of Egypt’s timeless legacy.

We do not visit Egypt inside a building only —
We discover Egypt written across the soul of Washington.

 1) OFFICIAL TOUR ROUTE 

1. U.S. Capitol

Theme: Power, Law & Sacred Authority

  • Ma’at → Justice → Constitution
  • Divine leadership in Egypt vs. Democracy in America
  • Sacred geometry → political order
  • Pharaohs → Presidents

2. Library of Congress

Theme: The House of Eternal Knowledge

  • Egypt → Greece → Rome → America
  • Hieroglyphs → Arabic → English
  • Library of Alexandria reborn
  • Knowledge as Egypt’s greatest universal gift

 3. National Museum of Natural History – 2nd Floor (Egyptian Section)

Theme: The Living Body of Civilization

  • Real mummies
  • Sarcophagi
  • Gods & goddesses
  • Daily life tools
  • Medicine, astronomy & afterlife
  • Death → Resurrection → Eternity

This is where Egypt is seen face to face.

4. Washington Monument

Theme: The American Obelisk

  • Direct Egyptian obelisk symbolism
  • Sun worship, resurrection & eternity
  • Mathematical perfection
  • Washington as modern cosmic axis

5. Lincoln Memorial & Reflecting Pool

Theme: Judgment, Memory & Moral Legacy

  • Lincoln seated like a Pharaoh
  • Water as symbolic Nile
  • Afterlife, remembrance & legacy
  • The Hall of Truth

6. Jefferson Memorial – Tidal Basin

Theme: Light, Creation & Cosmic Order

  • Sacred circular design
  • Water & rebirth
  • Enlightenment as modern Ra
  • Eternal cycle of civilization

2) CIVILIZATION STORYLINE 

Egypt → Knowledge → Body → Power → Law → Memory → Eternity

Egypt gave the world:

  • Science
  • Architecture
  • Time
  • Astronomy
  • Medicine
  • Ethics
  • Leadership

America reshaped these into:

  • Democracy
  • Law
  • Liberty
  • Global leadership

 welcome to Explore Egypt in Washington, D.C. — a journey where ancient civilization meets modern power.

Our story begins at the U.S. Capitol, where the Egyptian concept of sacred authority transformed into the American idea of law and democracy.

At the Library of Congress, we step into the world’s greatest house of knowledge — where the wisdom of Ancient Egypt lives beside the memory of all human civilizations.

Inside the National Museum of Natural History, we meet Egypt face to face: real mummies, real kings, real science, and the eternal belief in resurrection.

Before us rises the American Obelisk — the Washington Monument — directly inspired by Egypt’s sacred monuments of eternity.

At the Lincoln Memorial, we reflect upon moral judgment, legacy, and the sacred role of leadership.

And finally, at the Jefferson Memorial, surrounded by water and light, we witness the eternal rebirth of civilization.

This is not a tour.
This is a civilization revelation.”

The Tour is conducted every day except Fridays from 2:30pm pm until 4:30pm.

label: Presidential Inauguration Preview Tour in Washington DC
content:
Overview 

Walk in the footsteps of many US presidents on this tour of Washington DC. During this 1.5-2 hour experience, visit the essential locations in the Presidential Inauguration process, including the parade route down Pennsylvania Avenue and St. John’s Church, where presidents have traditionally had their pre-Inaugural prayer service. Make a stop at the White House, and see where the president and presidential spouse host the Inaugural Ball, then continue past sites such as the Jefferson and Lincoln Memorials and listen to your guide tell historical anecdotes about inaugurations past. Stop outside the US Capitol building, where the new president takes the oath of office. Expand your understanding of the Presidential Inaugural process during this limited-time tour operating between November and January. 

  • 2-Hour Presidential Inauguration Preview Tour in Washington DC 
  • Follow the Inauguration Parade Route down Pennsylvania Ave 
  • Stop outside the US Capitol, and see where the president is sworn in and gives the Inaugural Address 
  • Stop outside the White House and St. John’s Church
  • Pass by notable DC sites such as Jefferson Memorial, Lincoln Memorial, National Mall, and Tidal Basin 
  • Expand your understanding of the Presidential Inaugural process during this limited-time tour operating between November and January 

From $59.00

  • Stop outside U.S. Capitol to see where the stage will be set up, and learn more about the ceremony

What To Expect

See the US Capitol, where the president is sworn in and gives the Inaugural Address. 15 minutes • Admission Ticket Not Included 

  • White House 

Make at stop at the North Side of the White House and St. John’s Church, the location where all presidents attend mass before being sworn in as President. One of America’s most recognizable historical and political symbols is also the home and office of the President of the United States. 15 minutes • Admission Ticket Not Included 

  • St. John’s Church 

Make a stop at St. John’s Church, located across the street from the White House. This is where presidents attend their pre-inaugural prayer service before being sworn in. Admission Ticket Free 

  • Jefferson Memorial (Pass By) 

A 19-foot bronze statue of perhaps the most esteemed founding father sits beneath a columned rotunda in the style of the Roman Pantheon.

  • Itinerary subject to change due to Secret Service rerouting and security reasons
  • Tour also available in French, German, Italian and Spanish. Please advise at booking if additional language is required 
  • Due to security and street closures, this tour will not be operating on Inauguration Day. 
  • This tour/activity will have a maximum of 14 travelers

You can cancel up to 24 hours in advance of the experience for a full refund. 

  • For a full refund, you must cancel at least 24 hours before the experience’s start time. 
  • If you cancel less than 24 hours before the experience’s start time, the amount you paid will not be refunded. 
  • Any changes made less than 24 hours before the experience’s start time will not be accepted. 
  • Cut-off times are based on the experience’s local time. Learn more about cancellations

  • The George Washington Legacy Tour in Alexandria and Mount Vernon (leadership, vision, and founding philosophy)

  • Leadership → embodiment of vision and governance
  • Cultural heritage → voices of identity and struggle
  • Museums → repositories of human knowledge and global civilization

بطريقتهم الخاصة—سواء بالسير بين معالمها أو بالتعمق فكريًا في معانيها من أي مكان في العالم. ما يميز هذه الجولة هو دمج العمق الأكاديمي مع السرد الغامر. فإضافة بُعد المتاحف تحوّل التجربة إلى نظام ثقافي متكامل، حيث تصبح المتاحف عنصرًا أساسيًا لفهم الحضارة. تربط هذه الجولة بين: المعالم → رموز القيم الوطنية القيادة → تجسيد الرؤية والحكم التراث الثقافي → أصوات الهوية والتاريخ المتاحف → خزائن المعرفة الماضي بالحاضر، والمكان بالمعنى، والتاريخ المحلي بالحضارة العالمية. بفضل الوصول الفوري، والمرونة، وإمكانية الاستخدام مدى الحياة، تمثل جولة زهيري 4-في-1 نموذجًا جديدًا للسياحة الرقمية العالمية—حيث تلتقي المعرفة والتكنولوجيا والسرد لصناعة تجربة عميقة ودائمة.  حوار عبر القارات والقرون.

الإرث الخالد لإحدى أعظم حضارات الإنسانية

 مصر كما لم تختبرها من قبل.

الآثار المصرية في أعظم متاحف العالم

المسلات والرموز والمعالم في مدن العالم

كيف شكّلت مصر التراث العالمي والهوية الثقافية

 خريطة عالمية للتأثير المصري.

هذه ليست مجرد مجموعة كتب،

بل رحلة فكرية متكاملة:

تربط الحكمة القديمة بالحضارة الحديثة

تحوّل السياحة إلى معرفة وتأمل

تجسر بين مصر وأمريكا والعالم في سردٍ موحّد

تقدم تجربة علمية ثنائية اللغة (العربية والإنجليزية)

 طلاب التاريخ والثقافة والحضارة

 المرشدون السياحيون والمعلمون

 عشّاق مصر والتراث العالمي

 كل من يبحث عن المعنى العميق خلف الآثار والتاريخ

⸻

 تخيّل هذا…

تقف أمام نصب واشنطن…

لكن بدل أن ترى مجرد هيكل،

تدرك رسالة بدأت قبل آلاف السنين في مصر.

تلك اللحظة تغيّر كل شيء.
